choices.content: Both change by the same amount

question.prompt: For the data 10, 12, 13, 14, 100, which statistic changes more after the extreme value 100 is removed? ( )

solutions.explanation: The mean changes from 29.8 to 12.25, a large change; the median changes from 13 to 12.5, a small change. Extreme values have a greater effect on the mean.
solutions.title: Compare changes in mean and median
